notes: Started as hosted API evaluation -> clear preference toward Dedicated for predictable unit economics and support SLA.
POC metrics so far: p95 latency ~135ms on hosted for chat (short context), throughput limited by token budget; embeddings quality acceptable vs internal baseline.
Primary ask from product: support 200 concurrent chat sessions with p95 <150ms and warm KV cache behavior for sticky sessions.
Pricing conversation highlights: interested in 12-month commit with 2 tier options (base commit + burst pool).
Discussed burst model: allow up to 3x burst for 30-minute windows with throttled fallback to lower-cost model; customer requires explicit overage rates upfront.
Procurement quote needs: month-by-month ramp schedule (0-50% in month 1, 50-100% by month 3), clear overage invoicing cadence, and termination terms tied to SLA breaches.

Security: running SOC2 and ISO assessment internally; will require KMS integration and audit log export to Splunk; EU customers require data residency option (likely Redwood Private in future but VPC with residency tagging is acceptable now).
SE notes: recommend quantization on candidate models, enable prefix caching for chat to hit latency targets; propose 2 GPU pool sizes for POC (small: 4g, medium: 8g).
Next negotiation points: final commit number, burst sizing and policy, overage price per token, ramp crediting (discount during month-0 ramp), and invoicing cadence.
